mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 62 degrees with clear skies at Harriet Park and a Waning Crescent moon. If you are up early, look to the west over Mount Horeb at 5:13 AM to catch the ISS traveling toward Belleville.

Regarding city news, road work on Highway M moves into phase two this week, bringing traffic shifts, and the Military Ridge State Trail will see closures from mid-September to mid-November for a bridge replacement.

We have a busy schedule ahead. Today you can enjoy live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard or Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, check out yoga at Insight Wellness, and mark your calendars for trivia events happening next week at Hop Haus, the Wisconsin Brewing Company, and Paddy Mac's.

The Verona Police Department reported that on Sunday, August 30, they were informed of an inappropriate relationship involving a school staff member, leading to the arrest of 34-year-old Halla Nelson.
Today's flavor is Chocolate Covered Strawberry. The store opens today at 10:00 AM, so be sure to stop by and grab a scoop.
